title: Basic Science
description: A natural science course with laboratory, such as general chemistry or calculus-based physics, chosen from an approved list.
notes: Vanderbilt: 12 hours of basic science including at least one laboratory course; recommended CHEM 1601/1601L and PHYS 1601, 1602.

title: Open Elective
description: A free elective chosen by the student.

title: Liberal Arts Core
description: A humanities or social sciences course from the School of Engineering's liberal arts core.
notes: Vanderbilt: 18 hours (CS 1151 may count as three of them).

title: CS Depth
description: An upper-level computer science course (numbered 3000 or higher) or an approved ECE or mathematics course chosen by the student.

title: Technical Elective
description: An engineering, mathematics, or natural science course numbered 2000 or higher chosen by the student.

title: Computer Science Project
description: A team or individual project course in which students design and build a substantial software system.
notes: Choice slot: Vanderbilt's CS 3862, 3892, 4239, 4249, 4269, 4279, 4287, 4289, or 4359. Official descriptions are in data/raw/vanderbilt/courses/.
